<svg class="bbflow" viewBox="-2 -2 1004 420" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" role="img" aria-label="Black-box study pipeline: seven steps from defining the estimand to reporting results, with flaws A to C arising upstream in study design and flaws D to F arising downstream in analysis.">
<style>

  .bbflow .bsub { font-family: "IBM Plex Sans", "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; font-size: 12.5px; fill: #FFFFFF; opacity: 0.85; }
  .bbflow .let  { font-family: "IBM Plex Mono", Menlo, monospace; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; fill: #FFFFFF; }
</style>
<defs>

<line x1="565" y1="130.0" x2="581" y2="130.0" stroke="#0F1419" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#bb-arr)"/>
<g><rect x="584" y="64" width="124" height="132" rx="6" fill="#EEF6F5" stroke="#21918C" stroke-width="1.5"/>

<line x1="711" y1="130.0" x2="727" y2="130.0" stroke="#0F1419" stroke-width="1.5" marker-end="url(#bb-arr)"/>
